climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Syrah sits in its sweet spot, so the wines can show the style it is known for.
Rain picks up at harvest. Growers race to pick before rot sets in, and vintages vary more.

blurb.text: One of the smallest appellations in the Rhône valley, in the northern Rhône. It makes only red wine, made only from Syrah.
